subject: POC extension: add checkout-abandonment workflow + refine acceptance metrics
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Wallace <evan.wallace@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff recap and proposed evaluation plan

Evan — great to meet earlier. Quick recap & proposed next steps so we stay aligned before the pilot starts next week.

High-level POC scope (as discussed):
- Inference: recommend running two Redwood model variants (r-instruct-7B-q8 and r-flan-13B) behind your checkout API for product description enrichment and FAQ routing.
- Traffic: 2k synthetic end-to-end requests/day (sample dataset attached) + live shadowing on 5% of checkout traffic.
- Success metrics:
  - Latency: p95 <= 280ms for enrichment path under shadow load
  - Quality: automated BLEU/ROUGE not sufficient — primary metric is human-annotated correctness >= 85% on a 200-sample set (we'll run the rubric together)
  - Cost: tokens-per-op and projected monthly spend estimate in the attached timeline sheet

Owners & timeline:
- Redwood: Rishi (POC delivery), Monica (integration support)
- BrightCart: Evan (product owner), Ana (SA)
- Kickoff: 2026-10-20
- Phase 1 (integration + shadow): 2 weeks
- Phase 2 (human eval & A/B): 2 weeks

Action items for this week:
1) Evan: confirm sample dataset delivery (CSV) + expected API rate limits
2) Ana: share a short list of 6-8 representative failure cases you want prioritized for the eval rubric
3) Redwood: we send onboarding runbook + proposed test harness by EOD Tue (attached: proposed-poc-timeline.xlsx)

Attachments: brightcart_sample_orders.csv, proposed-poc-timeline.xlsx

—Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

From: Evan Wallace <evan.wallace@brightcart.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ana Soto <ana.soto@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap and proposed evaluation plan

Thanks Steph — this looks good and thanks for the clear owners/timeline. A couple of notes from our side after reviewing with the checkout team: 

1) Scope add request (mid-trial): can we include a short "checkout-abandonment" workflow as a secondary use case?
- Goal: generate a 1–2 sentence personalized recovery message based on cart contents + user intent signals.
- Why: quick win for conversion uplift; our growth team wants to see a revenue signal alongside quality metrics.

2) Dataset: sending the sample CSV tonight. It contains anonymized carts; we'll also share a small set of labeled abandonment examples (5–10) for the initial rubric.

3) Procurement: looping in procurement@brightcart.com — they asked if adding the abandonment workflow will change timeline or cost materially.

Can the team sketch how we would fold this into the existing plan (impact on acceptance criteria and timeline)?

Evan
Evan Wallace
Product Lead, BrightCart
evan.wallace@brightcart.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Wallace <evan.wallace@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap and proposed evaluation plan

Appreciate the quick reply, Evan — adding the abandonment workflow is reasonable as a secondary use case. Below is a proposed rebaseline we can confirm in tomorrow's kickoff.

Proposed changes (summary):
- Add secondary use case: checkout-abandonment recovery message generation.
- Traffic for secondary use case: 500 shadow requests/day (non-blocking).
- Additional acceptance criteria: initial conversion-proxy signal = 0.5% uplift in click-to-recover rate on labeled test set (measured in the 2-week A/B). We’ll treat this as a directional signal — primary pass/fail remains the human correctness rubric for both use cases.
- Timeline impact: +1 week to Phase 2 (so total pilot length becomes 5 weeks) to allow extra human eval and a short A/B on the abandonment variant.
- Cost impact: estimated +15% to compute budget (see attached updated timeline).

Owners (updated):
- Redwood: Rishi (overall delivery), Monica (integration + eval harness), Neha (quality & human evaluation coordination)
- BrightCart: Evan (product), Ana (SA), procurement@brightcart.com (commercial)

Next steps before kickoff (tomorrow):
- Evan/Ana: confirm dataset uploaded to Drive link and the 5–10 labeled examples for abandonment
- Procurement: confirm no change to MOU terms for a +1-week pilot extension (we can run on the existing MOU while we finalize commercial terms)
- Redwood: we’ll prepare an updated acceptance matrix and a checklist for the human evaluation protocol.

If that all sounds good I’ll update the timeline doc and we’ll kick off tomorrow 10/20 as planned.

—Steph

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Evan Wallace <evan.wallace@brightcart.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ana Soto <ana.soto@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap and proposed evaluation plan

Thanks — quick operational notes from the delivery side: 

- Integration: Monica and I will instrument a shadow endpoint that mirrors 5% of checkout traffic for enrichment and 5% separate for abandonment (configurable flags). We expect the shadow routing to be ready within 4 business days after we receive the signed MOU and the sample CSV.
- Eval harness: Neha will run the human annotation batch; we need a committed list of 200 joint samples (150 enrichment, 50 abandonment) for the primary rubric. If BrightCart can provide 70% of those examples, Redwood will augment the rest with synthetic variants.
- Acceptance matrix (high level):
  - Enrichment: human correctness >= 85% on 150-sample set; latency p95 <= 280ms
  - Abandonment: correctness >= 80% on 50-sample set; conversion-proxy uplift >= 0.5% measured in A/B
- Data handling: all uploaded CSVs will be stored in the private POC folder with KMS-backed encryption. No logs will be retained beyond the pilot window unless you opt-in.

I’ll attach a short checklist in Drive after the kickoff. For now, please confirm the sample upload and whether procurement is ok with a +1 week pilot window.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, POC Delivery, Redwood Inference

From: Ana Soto <ana.soto@brightcart.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Wallace <evan.wallace@brightcart.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Date: 2026-10-25T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap and proposed evaluation plan

All good from BrightCart — thanks for accommodating the abandonment workflow. Quick confirmations: 

- Dataset: uploaded to "Drive/POC-BC-0457" folder (brightcart_sample_orders.csv + 8 labeled abandonment examples).
- Procurement: ok to proceed under the draft MOU for the +1 week extension while commercial finalize. We’ll try to get the signed MOU next week.
- Acceptance: growth team is comfortable treating the 0.5% uplift as a directional signal; primary pass/fail will be the correctness rubrics.

Attachment: mou-draft-v2.pdf (for procurement review).

Looking forward to kickoff tomorrow.

Best,
Ana Soto
Solutions Architect, BrightCart
ana.soto@brightcart.com
